items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Speaking of Billy Eckstine, were you in the band when Billy came in? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, before we go into that, who was in the -- in Fuller's -- what'd you say, nine-piece band? Or eleven-piece band at the Grand Terrace?
Most of the Hines men. Omer Simeon who the stayed, I stayed/, Eck stayed on drums. I don't remember.
Was Oliver Coleman in the band then, or was that after Oliver?
